verdict.rationale: This story is about a configurable automation feature: rules that fire actions when events occur, as found in workflow or SaaS platforms. Vue.js is a front-end UI framework for building interfaces, not an end-user automation product, so the axis doesn't fit its product category. Its reactivity system lets developers write code that responds to events, but that is not user-defined automation rules, and nothing in the evidence shows Vue ships such a feature.
